## Terramar — *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic* (G4)

Terramar is Silverstream’s younger brother, a gentle young **hippogriff** caught between Mount Aris and the underwater kingdom of Seaquestria. His father, Sky Beak, lives on the mountain; his mother, Ocean Flow, lives beneath the waves. A piece of Queen Novo’s magic pearl lets him transform into a **seapony**—the same individual in another form, not a secret identity. His predicament drives the Cutie Mark Crusaders’ first friendship-map mission. [Character and appearance record](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Terramar).

**Recognize him:** Cream-white feathers, a two-tone turquoise crest and tail, cyan eyes, pale beak, and a purple necklace with turquoise beads and a pink shell pendant. Underwater, he has fins and a fishlike tail. [Official clip showing his seapony transformation and mother](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DAgfiF3QYxM).

**Name and voice:** “Terramar” is his **spoken, official television name**, introduced in *Surf and/or Turf* (S8E6), not a fandom nickname. Its apparent wordplay is Latin *terra* (“land”) + *mare* (“sea”); no earlier character name or separate alter ego is verified. He speaks in both his major episodes; **Cole Howard** is his English voice actor, as confirmed by [Howard’s Ponyville Ciderfest guest profile](https://ponyvilleciderfest.com/2020/guests/cole-howard/).

**Appearances:** He debuts in *Surf and/or Turf* (S8E6), is mentioned in *A Rockhoof and a Hard Place* (S8E21), and returns in *Uprooted* (S9E3), *Student Counsel* (S9E11, with dialogue), *The Last Crusade* (S9E12), *The Ending of the End – Part 2* (S9E25), and a brief *The Last Problem* (S9E26) image. These are G4 television appearances, not evidence of another continuity.

## Important moments

1. **Admitting he belongs in both worlds — “Surf and/or Turf” (S8E6).** Terramar tells the Crusaders he fears letting down a parent whichever home he chooses. [Verified full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jRt9I66zc7o); **scene timestamp unavailable**.
2. **A family picnic resolves the dilemma — “Surf and/or Turf” (S8E6).** After a frustrated retreat into a tree, Terramar hears both parents reassure him that he can keep visiting both homes; their acceptance completes the Crusaders’ mission. [Alternate official full-episode upload](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CxJE-CuAGYQ); **scene timestamp unavailable**.
3. **Refusing to give up on Silverstream — “Student Counsel” (S9E11).** He alerts Starlight when his sister fails to arrive home, joins the dangerous search, and insists they keep looking despite the cockatrices. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oNv4jfY-xcA); **scene timestamp unavailable**.
